faq.q: How do I download a TikTok video without watermark?
faq.a: Open TikTok, tap Share on any video, then Copy Link. Paste the link above and click Download. Choose "HD · No Watermark" to save a clean video without the TikTok logo burned in.

faq.q: Is TokDown free to use?
faq.a: Yes. There is no registration, no account and no premium plan. The site is paid for by ads. When the upstream TikTok service is busy you may be asked to retry in a few minutes.

faq.q: Can I download TikTok audio as MP3?
faq.a: Yes. After fetching the video you will see an "Audio MP3" button to save only the sound track. Useful for TikTok sounds, background music, and voiceovers.

faq.q: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
faq.a: Yes. TokDown is a web app — open it in Safari (iPhone), Chrome (Android), or any modern browser. No app install needed.

faq.q: How do I save a TikTok video to my iPhone camera roll?
faq.a: After downloading, the video saves to your Files app. Open Files, find the video, tap Share, then "Save Video" to move it to your Camera Roll.

faq.q: How do I save a TikTok video on Android?
faq.a: Tap the download button and the video saves directly to your Downloads folder. Open it in your Gallery app from there.

faq.q: Why can't I download a private TikTok video?
faq.a: Private videos require login authentication that we cannot access. Only public TikTok videos are downloadable. If the video is public and still failing, the creator may have disabled downloads in their settings.

faq.q: What video quality is available?
faq.a: We offer HD (the highest resolution the creator uploaded) and SD versions, both without the watermark. HD is recommended for sharing or editing.

faq.q: What formats does TokDown support?
faq.a: Videos download as MP4 (HD or SD, no watermark). Audio downloads as MP3. MP4 plays on all devices; MP3 works in any music app.

faq.q: Is it safe to use TokDown?
faq.a: Yes. TokDown never asks for your TikTok credentials and does not store any video files. The video is streamed through our server straight to your device and is never saved along the way.

faq.q: Why does TikTok add a watermark in the first place?
faq.a: TikTok embeds a watermark on videos saved through their native app to encourage sharing back on the platform and to brand the content. TokDown fetches the original source file before the watermark is applied, so what you get is the clean version.

faq.q: Can I download TikTok slideshows or photo posts?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the link of a photo post or slideshow into the TikTok photo downloader (tokdown.org/photo-downloader) and save every image in full size, one by one or all at once, plus the sound as MP3.

faq.q: Is it safe to download TikTok videos?
faq.a: Yes. TokDown never asks for your TikTok login and never stores videos on its servers. The file is fetched from TikTok's CDN and streamed to your device in a single pass — nothing is kept. We have no access to your TikTok account.

faq.q: How do I download TikTok without installing an app?
faq.a: Open tokdown.org in any browser on your phone or computer — Safari, Chrome, Firefox, or Edge. No app download or installation is required. Just paste the link and download.

faq.q: Can I download TikTok videos on a PC or laptop?
faq.a: Yes. Open tokdown.org in Chrome, Edge, or Firefox on Windows or Mac. Paste the TikTok link and click Download. The video saves to your Downloads folder as an MP4 file.

faq.q: Why is my downloaded TikTok video blurry?
faq.a: You most likely selected the SD option instead of HD. Go back and choose "HD · No Watermark" for the sharpest quality. Also make sure your internet connection was stable during the download — a slow connection can cause incomplete downloads.

faq.q: How long does a TikTok download take?
faq.a: Most downloads complete in 5–15 seconds. Longer videos (3–10 minutes) or slower internet connections may take up to 30 seconds. There are no queues or waiting times.

faq.q: Is downloading TikTok videos legal?
faq.a: It depends on your country and on what you do with the file. Many countries allow a private copy for personal viewing, but TikTok's terms restrict downloading outside its own features, and re-uploading, redistributing or monetising someone else's video without permission is copyright infringement almost everywhere. Use TokDown for personal use and for your own content.

faq.q: Can I download TikTok Live streams?
faq.a: No. TikTok Live streams are broadcast in real time and are not stored as downloadable video files. Only recorded (non-live) public TikTok videos can be downloaded with TokDown.

faq.q: Does TokDown work without a TikTok account?
faq.a: Yes. TokDown only works with publicly available TikTok videos and does not require any TikTok account — yours or anyone else's. Simply paste the public video link and download.

About.metaTitle: About TokDown – Who Makes This Downloader
About.metaDescription: How TokDown works: where downloads come from, what is never stored, how ads pay for the site and how to reach us. Free tools, no account needed.
About.subtitle: TokDown is a small set of free download and media tools. This page explains how it works, what it does not do, and how it is paid for.
About.story1: Most "free" TikTok downloaders have the same playbook: bury the real download button under three fake ones, redirect you through ad domains, make you solve captchas, and — some of them — even ask for your TikTok username and password. We think that is unacceptable.
About.story2: TokDown was built to be the tool we wished existed: fast, clean, and honest. You paste a link. You get your video. That's it.
About.story3: We do not store any video files on our servers. When you hit download, the file is streamed from TikTok's CDN through our server to your device without ever being saved. We keep no record of what you downloaded; standard server logs are deleted automatically after 30 days.
About.how1: When you paste a link, TokDown detects the platform and asks a public source for the media: for TikTok a third-party API (TikWM), with TikTok's public video page as a fallback; for X the public data used for embedded tweets; for Facebook the public video embed. You get the file the platform serves, without re-encoding.
About.how2: The "no watermark" version is the original file as uploaded by the creator before TikTok's app overlays the logo. Both versions exist on TikTok's CDN; TokDown simply surfaces the right one.
About.how3: The file is streamed through our server to your device in a single pass, because platform CDNs refuse direct browser downloads; nothing is written to disk. The video compressor and the MP4 to GIF converter work differently: they run entirely in your browser and your file is never uploaded.
About.legal: TokDown is intended for personal, non-commercial use only. Always respect the rights of TikTok creators — downloading a video does not transfer copyright. Do not redistribute, re-upload, or monetise downloaded content without explicit permission from the original creator. TokDown is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to TikTok or ByteDance in any way.
About.contact: Questions, bug reports or a copyright notice? Write to support@tokdown.org. Copyright notices follow the process described on our DMCA page.

GuideNoWatermark.why1: When you save a video using TikTok's built-in "Save video" button, TikTok overlays a watermark — your username and the TikTok logo — before saving it to your camera roll. This is intentional: it drives people who see the video elsewhere back to TikTok.
GuideNoWatermark.why2: The original video file (without watermark) is still hosted on TikTok's CDN. TokDown fetches that original file directly, bypassing the watermark entirely. The process is the same technical mechanism that TikTok's own embedding feature uses.
GuideNoWatermark.legal: Saving a public TikTok for private viewing is tolerated in many countries (for example as a private copy), but TikTok's terms restrict downloading outside its own features, and the rules differ by country. What is clearly not allowed is redistributing, re-uploading or monetising downloaded videos without the creator's explicit permission. Always credit the original creator and respect their copyright.

FacebookDownloader.faqSubtitle: Short answers to the usual questions.

faq.q: Why does a video fail to download?
faq.a: It is private, posted in a closed group, age-restricted, or a live stream. Only videos visible to everyone without logging in can be fetched.

faq.q: Can I download Facebook Reels?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the Reel link exactly as Facebook gives it to you and you will get an MP4.

faq.q: Is there a watermark?
faq.a: No. You receive the original file Facebook streams, without any added overlay.

faq.q: Does it work on iPhone?
faq.a: Yes. Safari saves the MP4 to Files; from there you can move it to Photos.

faq.q: Is this legal?
faq.a: Downloading for personal, offline viewing of content you have the right to use is fine. Re-uploading other people’s videos is not. Respect creators and Facebook’s terms.

faq.q: Does it work on Android and iPhone?
faq.a: Yes. On Android the MP4 lands in your Downloads folder and shows up in the gallery. On iPhone, Safari saves it to Files, and the Share menu lets you move it to Photos.

faq.q: Can I download just the audio from a Facebook video?
faq.a: Download the MP4 first, then use the video compressor or any audio extractor. A direct MP3 option is on the roadmap.

FacebookDownloader.ctaSubtitle: Paste it and save the video in seconds.
details: Facebook serves most public videos in two renditions, an HD file for fast connections and an SD file for mobile data. TokDown reads both from the same public embed Facebook uses for its own share buttons, which is why no login, cookie or browser extension is needed. You get the original MP4 as uploaded by the page, with the original aspect ratio and no added watermark or logo.

Reels, Watch episodes, videos posted on pages and public profile videos all work, including fb.watch short links and the long share URLs the mobile app produces. Videos inside closed groups, private profiles, stories and live broadcasts are not available to anyone who is not logged in, so they cannot be fetched here either. If a link fails, open it in a private browser window first: if Facebook asks you to log in, the video is not public.

TwitterDownloader.ctaSubtitle: Paste the link and pick a quality.
details: Every video uploaded to Twitter / X is stored in several MP4 renditions, typically 320p, 480p, 720p and, for recent uploads, 1080p. TokDown lists them by bitrate and offers the best one first, so you always get the sharpest copy the author uploaded. Animated GIFs on X are actually short silent MP4 files; you receive them as MP4 as well, which is smaller and plays everywhere, and you can turn them back into a real GIF with our MP4 to GIF tool.

The tool reads the same public data X publishes for embedded tweets, so protected accounts, deleted tweets and posts marked as sensitive cannot be read without logging in and will return an error rather than a wrong file. Short t.co links are resolved automatically, and links copied from the X app, from twitter.com or from a message all work the same way.

faq.q: Why is there no 1280×720 image?
faq.a: YouTube only generates the maxres thumbnail when the uploaded video and custom thumbnail are high resolution. Older or low-res videos only have the smaller sizes.

faq.q: Can I use the thumbnail in my own video?
faq.a: Thumbnails belong to the channel that made them. Use them for reference, previews and your own channel; ask before reusing someone else’s artwork.

faq.q: Does this download the video?

faq.q: Does it work for private videos?

faq.q: What is the YouTube thumbnail size?
faq.a: The recommended upload size is 1280×720 pixels (16:9), under 2 MB, as JPG, PNG or GIF. That is also the size of the maxresdefault image this tool returns.

faq.q: Can I download a thumbnail from a YouTube Short?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the Shorts link; the tool extracts the video ID and lists the same sizes YouTube provides for regular videos.

tool.invalid: That does not look like a YouTube link or an 11-character video ID.

details: YouTube generates up to five thumbnail sizes for every video: 120×90, 320×180, 480×360, 640×480 and the full HD 1280×720 version called maxresdefault. All of them are public JPG files served from YouTube’s image servers. TokDown builds the exact URLs from the video ID, checks which sizes exist and shows a preview of each, so you can pick the resolution you need without guessing.

Creators use this to recover a thumbnail they no longer have the source for, to build playlists and channel pages, or to compare how competitors design their covers. Designers paste the direct URL into Figma or Canva. Because only the image is fetched, the tool is fast, works for Shorts and regular videos alike, and never touches the video stream itself.

VideoCompressor.faqSubtitle: What people ask before pressing the button.

faq.q: Is my video uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: No. The compressor runs entirely in your browser. You can even go offline after the page has loaded.

faq.q: Why is it slower than an online service?
faq.a: Because it uses your own device’s CPU instead of a server. A 1-minute 1080p clip typically takes one to three minutes on a laptop, longer on a phone.

faq.q: How much smaller will the file be?
faq.a: Usually 50 to 80% smaller with the Balanced preset. Already-compressed screen recordings shrink less.

faq.q: What is the maximum file size?
faq.a: 500 MB per file. Larger files can exhaust the memory a browser tab is allowed to use.

faq.q: Does it work on iPhone?
faq.a: Yes, in Safari 16 or newer. Very long videos may be slow; try the Small preset first.

faq.q: How do I compress a video for Discord?
faq.a: Choose the Small preset. It brings most clips under the free Discord upload limit; for longer videos, trim them first or use a lower resolution screen recording.

faq.q: Can I compress a video to 10 MB?
faq.a: There is no exact target size setting yet, but the Small preset typically reduces a one-minute 1080p phone video to 5 to 12 MB. Re-run with the same preset on the result if you need it smaller.

details: Most online compressors upload your video to a server, process it there and let you download the result. TokDown does the opposite: the ffmpeg encoder is loaded as WebAssembly into your browser tab and the whole job runs on your own device. Your file never leaves your computer or phone, there is no queue, no size-based paywall and no watermark. The first run downloads the encoder once; after that it is cached.

The three presets map to the limits people actually hit. Small targets WhatsApp, Telegram and e-mail attachments by capping resolution at 720p with a higher compression ratio. Balanced keeps up to 1080p for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube uploads. Quality keeps the most detail for archiving or further editing. All presets output H.264 video with AAC audio in an MP4 container, which plays on every phone, browser and editing app.

faq.q: How do I make a GIF from a TikTok?
faq.a: Download the TikTok as MP4 with TokDown first, then drop that file here.

faq.q: Why is the GIF large?
faq.a: GIF is an old format: every frame is a full image. Lower the width or the frame rate, or shorten the clip.

faq.q: Can I make a GIF longer than 15 seconds?
faq.a: Not here. Longer GIFs become tens of megabytes; for long clips, use the video compressor and share an MP4.

faq.q: Does it keep sound?
faq.a: No. GIFs cannot carry audio.

faq.q: How do I make a GIF from an iPhone video?
faq.a: Open this page in Safari, tap the drop zone, choose the video from Photos, set the clip and tap Create GIF. The GIF saves to Files and can be shared from there.

faq.q: What is the best setting for a small GIF?
faq.a: Start with 320 px width, 12 fps and a clip under 5 seconds. Reduce the frame rate before reducing the width if it is still too large.

details: GIF is a 30-year-old format with a 256-colour palette and no compression between frames, which is why naive converters produce huge, grainy files. TokDown runs a two-pass ffmpeg pipeline in your browser: the first pass analyses your clip and builds a custom palette, the second pass maps every frame to it with ordered dithering. The result keeps text readable and gradients smooth at a fraction of the size.

You control the three things that decide file size: the clip length (up to 15 seconds), the frame rate (10 to 24 fps) and the width (240 to 800 pixels). For chat apps, 480 px at 15 fps is a good default; for documentation or a README, 640 px at 12 fps looks crisp and stays small. Because everything runs locally, you can iterate as many times as you like without uploading anything.
